question: What follows after the method of enunciation has been declared?
premises: The method of enunciation has been declared for easy comprehension.
The next task is to examine the characteristics of what was enunciated.
These characteristics will be explained in due order.
inference: Having completed the outline, the text now turns to a systematic explanation of the defining characteristics of its topics.
plain_english: Thus the method of enunciation has been declared for the sake of easy comprehension. Now, in examining its characteristics, they will be explained in due order.
